text: In the year of 2023 41,100 deaths among men and 33,000 among women in Germany were caused bychronic ischemic heart disease. Overall, cardiovascular diseases caused one-third of all registered deaths in thecountry [8]. A key factor in preventing risks of many diseases, including heart conditions, is keeping a healthy,well-balanced diet. Accurate nutritional assessment plays an important role in both managing existing healthconditions and promoting overall well-being. Traditionally, this is done by registered dietitians to meet theindividual’s needs based on their personal goals and health risks.With the rapid progression in the development of large language models (LLMs) in recent years, the interestin leveraging these technologies for nutritional guidance and dietary estimation was sparked [4] [3] [11].This technology could make the nutritional assessment available to a broader number of people, who do nothave access to a consultation by a dietitian for various reasons including financial situations.LLMs like GPT show potential in the field of nutrition, however the majority of existing research and datasetsused for fine-tuning and evaluation are predominantly derived from the U.S. [9] [7], creating a gap inunderstanding their accuracy when applied in non-american dietary contexts.German culinary culture consists of many regional and local dishes, is deeply rooted in history and is still abig part of the nation’s diet.
